measurement_notes.candidate_generation: Timed connector/status/radius filtering; excludes route table precomputation.
measurement_notes.picker_time: Timed selection function calls; descriptive, single-process measurement.
measurement_notes.wall_time: Full evaluation for one demand level, shared by all algorithms.
measurement_notes.memory: Process peak RSS high-water mark; not isolated per algorithm.
measurement_notes.matching_metrics: Not applicable: no entity labels or predicted match pairs.
measurement_notes.simulation: Synthetic station state, origins, driver profiles, traffic, arrivals and charge outcomes.
measurement_notes.paired_interval: Normal-approximation 95% CI over trial-level paired mean total times; not a claim about field outcomes.
